limitations: Each lambda window is only 30 fs, including 10 fs discarded by construction; this cannot establish conformer mixing or equilibrium.
The fixed AM1-BCC/OBC-II/ACE solvent provider is sampled because it supplies conservative forces; the more accurate energy-only CHA-GB/cavity-dispersion candidate is not substituted.
TI is reported as a development cross-check. MBAR and its overlap matrix require the upstream pymbar analysis dependency and are not fabricated here.
Only three development molecules and three named registered MLIPs are included.
Experimental labels are opened only after label-free sample records are written, but this is not a sealed confirmation partition.
